title: Jetavana
text: Idaṃ hitaṃ Jetavanaṃ || isisaṅghanisevitaṃ || āvutthaṃ dhammarājena || pītisañjananam mama || || [page 034] 34 DEVATĀ-SAṂYUTTA I. [I. 5. 8. kammaṃ vijjā ca dhammo ca || sīlaṃ jīvitam uttamaṃ || etena maccā sujjhanti || na gottena dhanena vā || || Tasmā hi paṇḍito poso || sampassaṃ attham attano || yoniso vicine dhammaṃ || evaṃ tattha visujjhati || || Sāriputto va paññāya || sīlena upasamena ca || yo pi pāragato bhikkhu || etāva paramo siyāti || ||
